items.briefing:
A Victorian woman has lost AUD $13,000 after falling victim to a convincing bank scam call — a timely reminder that phone-based fraud remains a serious threat. Scammers often impersonate banks or government agencies, creating urgency to pressure people into transferring money quickly. Separately, a new Australian AI tool called AIBUILD has launched to help verify whether messages are scams, which could offer useful protection as these attacks grow more sophisticated.

Australian executives are also being cautioned about over-relying on AI tools, with findings suggesting AI systems can produce audit errors that go undetected. If your organisation uses AI to support decision-making, always have a human review important outputs before acting on them.

featured.title: Australian executives trust AI despite audit error findings
featured.summary: Despite audit findings of errors, most executives still trust AI output, even as poor data quality is blocking wider use in Australia.
